about: Accepted exceptions to scripts/boundary_lint.py (docs/SECURITY.md, "Owner trust rules"). Each entry is one file and rule, one reason, and the source line of every accepted hit, whitespace collapsed. tests/test_boundary_lint.py fails on a hit that is not listed and on a listed line no hit matches, so the list only shrinks: remove a line when its hit is fixed.

exceptions.reason: The staged-file claim renames the resident's entry out of state/ by path; the claim is then read without following a link, as a single-linked regular file.
Only the resident's fetch_url CLI writes this shared log; the owner's digest imports only the address checks, which write nothing.
Container init copies the bytes of a file another uid left in the ea-bot volume so ea-bot owns it; the content is never parsed, sourced or used.
Opens the path chat.load_frontend names: <private_dir>/webchat.sqlite in an owner process (or its own chat.json's store_path), <ea_dir>/state/ only outside one.
apply-staged replays a staged doc_review open. It runs only as the resident (codex_turn._apply_staged starts it through the resident's sudo), and no owner process calls it.
